orbis.atlas.size_tip: Minimap size: small, medium, large. Saved between sessions.
orbis.atlas.title: Orbis atlas
orbis.atlas.name: Name
orbis.atlas.corner_tip: Minimap corner: TR, TL, BR, BL. Click to move.
orbis.atlas.check_tip: Check this world without loading terrain.
orbis.atlas.sort_tip: Sort by name, sample hits or discovery status.
orbis.atlas.check_structures_tip: Check existence: up to 256 more candidate positions. Stop when all types, including portal rooms, are found. Counts remain lower bounds.
orbis.atlas.check_biomes_tip: Quick biome check: at most 1,024 queries. Search+ adds up to 4,096 queries for missing types. Stops when all expected types are found.
orbis.atlas.count_tip: Explicit full count across this finite dimension. Can take a long time in large worlds. Pause with Pause; Count all resumes it. Completed counts restart.
orbis.atlas.map_tip: Sample more surface biomes for the checklist. Saved or loaded chunks show real terrain; other areas show a fictional map pattern.
orbis.atlas.reset_structures_tip: Reset predicted counts and candidate cursors, retain observations, then run a bounded existence check.
orbis.atlas.reset_biomes_tip: Restart the small biome search. Retains observations and saved map detail.
orbis.atlas.layers_tip: Overlay: off, chunk grid, structures, both. Click to cycle.
orbis.atlas.biome_queries: %s biome queries. These do not reveal terrain on the map or count saved chunks.
orbis.atlas.portal_tip: Stronghold portal room: counts layouts, not active portals or proof of intact frame blocks.
orbis.atlas.structure_predicted: Generator prediction; saved terrain may differ. Not found does not prove absence.
orbis.atlas.portal_seen_tip: Portal block observed in a loaded chunk; not a generated structure type.
orbis.atlas.dimension_tip:
Current dimension: %s
Expected biomes come from its generator, including mod biomes. A completed sample does not prove completeness. Unconfirmed does not mean absent.
orbis.atlas.narration_structures: Orbis structures. %s. Structure types and End portal room layouts in this dimension. Predictions use the current generator; saved terrain may differ. Check, pause or resume the search. Unconfirmed does not mean absent. Select a found place to center it.
orbis.atlas.narration_atlas: Orbis atlas. %s of %s biomes found; %s unconfirmed. W A S D move the map. Plus and minus zoom. Home centers the player. Page up and down browse the list. Tab selects controls. Escape closes. O means observed, tilde predicted, question mark unconfirmed. The world keeps running.
orbis.atlas.follow_tip: Keep the player centered. Dragging or WASD turns following off. Home turns it on again.
